ph: Swamishri with the Governer of Gujarat

w: 31 devotees and sadhus travelled by foot from Surat to Sarangpur, chanting the Swaminarayan mahamantra, as part of the ‘Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebration’. It took them two weeks to cover 375 kms, finally concluding at Sarangpur for the Fuldol festival.

Swamishri’s blessings: "... Getting sprayed with colored water is a physical event, but the message and essence prescribed by the holy great is that the colour should penetrate within... To get colored spiritually means our life becomes God conscious, inspired to offer devotion to God and to serve others - this is the message behind this festival of colors.

It was an awesome, colorful celebration of spiritual joy and enlightenment. The experience of being drenched at the hands of Swamishri was the climax and ultimate moment for thousands of devotees who came from far and wide.

The program commenced in the serene hours of the morning when Swamishri performed his daily worship. The bhajans of Holi and Vasant by the sadhus enriched the atmosphere. A beautiful backdrop created a natural spring environment, lush with artificial flowers, hedges, trees and birds. A cascade of water gently weaved down a small mountain. An image of Lord Swaminarayan on a swing and Swamishri performing his puja added life to the colorful stage.

A steady stream of devotees flowed into the assembly hall, starting from as early as 6.00 am. Many had left as early as 1.00 am or 2.00 am, some at 4.30 am to reach Sarangpur. They travelled by coaches, cars and vans.

After Swamishri’s puja the main assembly commenced at 8.00 am. The speeches by senior sadhus set the tempo for the occasion. The history and significance of Fuldol and the purpose of sprinkling colored water was elaborately explained by the senior sadhus. The intermittent singing of bhajans gave a devotional and emotional flair to the occasion.

Swamishri performed the opening ceremony of several new audio, video and print publications: 1. ‘A Handbook to the Vachanamrutam’ (English) by Sadhu Mukundcharandas. 2. ‘Vachanamrut Rahashya’ (Gujarati) by Sadhu Brahmadarshandas. 3. Yogiji Maharaj Ki Bodhkathae (Hindi) : Shri Yogendraprakashji 4. Shikshapatri (audio): Sung by professional singers. 5. Satsang Darshan (Video): Vicharan of Swamishri.

The arrival of Dr. Subramaniyam, who had performed the bypass surgery of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, evoked a feeling of surprise and admiration. After being welcomed and garlanded by Swamishri Dr. Subramaniyam said, "God’s greatest gift to me, Lord Swaminarayan’s greatest gift to me, was in July last year when I operated on Pramukhji. It was a divine moment when I met Pramukhji for the first time. Two things impressed me when I met Pramukhji and which my father taught me. The first is karma - do your duty. The second is that we are born to give. I am sure that Pramukhji enlightens you all of this. I am here as a servant and I am delighted that Pramukhji is well to be with us today." Dr. Nilesh Patel, who assisted Dr. Subramaniyam during Swamishri’s operation, was also welcomed and honored.

Swamishri was then garlanded by senior sadhus. In blessing the 35,000 devotees in the assembly Swamishri said, "We are celebrating a divine festival. Bhagwan Swaminarayan celebrated this festival in Gadhada and other holy places. He had also celebrated the Fuldol festival here in Sarangpur, spraying colored water on the devotees. Shastriji Maharaj too, after establishing this mandir, celebrated this festival here... Getting sprayed with colored water is a physical event... but the essence and message of the holy great behind this is that we should get colored from within. When our clothes get colored we become physically purer, our senses get purer and our soul becomes purer. To get colored spiritually means our life becomes God conscious, we are inspired to offer devotion to God and to serve others - this is the message behind this festival of colors. "God sprayed the colors to transform our feelings, our inner colors, and to increase our devotion for Him. The Holi festival and the festival of Fuldol have been prescribed by our scriptures. "We should have an aim or direction in life. We don’t know what is the purpose of this human life. The incarnations of God and the great holy sadhus descend on this earth to show the true goal and means of fulfillment in life... Our goal is not to eat, drink and be happy and indulge in worldly pleasures. Our goal is God and Satsang... to become attached to a God-communion sadhu and tread the path of Satsang... To please God, to walk the path of dharma, to develop love for the devotees and attachment for a God- communion sadhu - this is the goal of life... "We have to do our duties in life but all our actions do not lead us to moksha. They do not lead us to God... So in the Shikshapatri Maharaj has said, "Nijatmanam brahmaroopam..." One should realise oneself as the atman (soul) and then offer worship to God."

After Swamishri’s blessings the countdown for the moment everyone had been waiting for began. A wave of excitement and eagerness to be colored swelled in every heart. 35,000 devotees were charged for the final moments.

Thereafter Swamishri sprayed some fragrant colored water on the image of Harikrishna Maharaj. Dr. Subramaniyam and Dr. Nilesh also sprayed colored water on Harikrishna Maharaj. Then Swamishri squeezed and sprayed the colored water on Dr. Subramaniyam amidst claps of appreciation from the devotees. Dr. Nilesh, Shri Bhupendrasinh Chudasama, Minister for the Narmada dam project and Shri Ashok Bhatt, the Health Minister, also received the spray of colored water from Swamishri.

Swamishri then sprayed the fragrant holy water on the devotees. The rhythm and devotion of the bhajan: ‘Vartal gaam fulvadiyae Hindolo Ambani dal’ and subsequent devotional songs by the sadhus energised the atmosphere. For nearly two hours Swamishri sprayed the devotees with the colored water. Each and every devotee returned blessed and overwhelmed with a spirit of sheer joy and memories of an unparalleled occasion. The Fuldol program ended at 1.30 pm.

In the evening assembly, Swamishri witnessed a beautifully choreographed 35 minute dance presentation, 'Sabrang', by children and youth members. During his blessings Swamishri said, "If one remembers God then one's mind will become calm and peaceful. You should study your very best, and do your homework properly. By studying well, you will be able to support your parents, serve society and the nation in the future. And by offering devotion to God you will be blessed with happiness and redemption…"
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha at the newly inaugurated Swaminarayan Mandir.
During late afternoon Swamishri arrived at Kheralu and performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony for a new mandir.
At 7.45pm Swamishri arrived in Modasa and was welcomed by devotees and dignitaries.

At 11.00 am, the Lt. Governor of New Delhi, Shri Vijay Kapoor, visited the Akshardham site. He was highly impressed by the quality and pace of construction of the Akshardham monument. He met Swamishri and expressed his joy about the construction work.
Swamishri arrived in Gadhada at 6.40 p.m. Here, Swamishri had darshan at the Shri Hari Smruti Mandir, where Shriji Maharaj was cremated, and other sanctified spots.
At 10.25 am Swamishri departed from Bhavnagar and arrived in Sarangpur via Vallabhipur at 11.35 am.

In the evening Swamishri attended an assembly of 4,375 volunteers who had come to serve in the rangotsav the next day. Swamishri blessed them by inspiring them to sincerely serve the devotees the next day, “Who purifies us! It is the Gunatit Sadhu. Our mother is Gunatitanand Swami, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. They purify us through their divine discourses. They free us from addictions and base nature and make us pure. Thereafter Maharaj embraces us and blesses us with the happiness of Akshardham. To attain this we have mandirs, festivals and spiritual discourses. By sitting inside the mandir we are freed of worldly inclinations and attachment for the body. We are also redeemed of a faultfinding attitude and learn to appreciate each others virtues. “Sevak means one who is a servant of servants. Only then does one derives happiness. But if one comes here as a boss, then one can never experience inner joy. We all have to become servants. A volunteer does not need any praise or glory. We should focus on serving others.”

At 7.35 pm Swamishri first performed pujan of and then sprayed coloured water on Harikrishna Maharaj. Thereafter everyone performed arti of Thakorji. Finally Swamishri showered coloured holy water on the volunteers.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj was doing darshan of Harikrishna Maharaj. Harishbhai Bhuptani, who had come from Uganda, asked Swamishri, "How should we do darshan?"
Answering in a single sentence, Swamishri said, "If we forget ourselves and do darshan of God, happiness comes."

After his meal, Pramukh Swami Maharaj blessed a student on the phone. This student had scored 93% in Class 10, but the tension of the coming Class 12 board exams had grown so much that, despite being bright, he had lost confidence, and because of the inner strain he had had a fit. He had lost heart, and blessing him for the board exam coming in just two days, Swamishri said, "Remember Maharaj and take the exam. Maharaj will be gracious. Pray. We will pray too. What you have learnt you will write properly, and you will pass with good marks."
With just these few sentences from Swamishri his courage grew, he took the exam, and he was also able to get a good percentage.

ds.t: Remember Maharaj and write your exam
w: After the meal Swamishri blessed a student on the phone. This student, who had scored 93% in tenth grade, had become so anxious about the coming twelfth grade board exams that, though bright, he had lost confidence, and the inner strain had brought on a fit. Two days before the board exams, blessing the boy who had lost heart, Swamishri said, "Remember Maharaj and give the exam. Maharaj will be kind. Pray. We will pray too. What you have learned you will write properly, and you will pass with good marks."
With these few words of Swamishri his courage grew, he sat the exam, and he got good marks too.

ds.t: One virtue among a hundred faults
w: As Mahant Swami Maharaj was coming down by lift after darshan in the mandir, a sadhu standing below said, "In the Yogi Gita, Yogiji Maharaj has said, 'To put forward one virtue among 100 faults, that is friendliness.'"

After that, as Swamishri moved on towards the assembly hall for his daily puja, referring to the sentence spoken earlier, he said in humour to a devotee standing there, "So now first I should look for 100 faults, and then take one virtue."
Smiling, Swamishri spoke a meaningful sentence: "That is just what goes on."
This short 4 word sentence of Swamishri's was one that makes us look within.
